separation: Authenticated author and independent reviewer must differ; operator and host administrator cannot grant project authority.
bootstrapAuthentication: Project authority must authenticate and explicitly authorize exact repository/application/configuration/snapshot/request bytes; test identities and unsigned fixtures are inadmissible.
receiptPolicy: Independently verifiable authenticated or signed receipts bound to repository, application, request, proof, policy, sequence, previous journal digest and Canonical digest; real trust material must be pinned before acceptance.
admission: Existing Canonical validity and exact approved snapshot digest required; no renumbering or weakened admission.
planVerification: Reproduce the exact genesis/adoption plan using a reviewed verifier; independently authenticate the reviewer proof, scope, validity and exact request/plan bindings before append. Legacy adapter does not support direct later-revision baseline adoption.
journal: Atomic append with expected-head compare-and-swap, immutable entries, reproducible snapshots and independent witnessed head checkpoints.
continuity: Verify every sequence and previous digest from explicitly authorized new genesis; no prior acceptance asserted.
rejection: Reject tamper, wrong application/repository, stale head, replayed or expired proof, unknown keys, self approval and missing prerequisites.
recovery: Atomic crash recovery and exact-request idempotency; ambiguous commit resolved by authenticated head read; restore behind witnessed head fails closed. Never delete accepted entries or reuse sequences.
